title: CTAS delivery
description: ctas/delivery.json: how the deployed site serves dossier chunks (identity on main and previews, gzip on GitHub Pages) and, since the delivery batch of 2026-10-29, where it serves them from: candidate_chunk_origin names the raw.githubusercontent.com address of the exact ctas-data commit the deployed release came from, the branch tip as a second try, and whether the site keeps its own copy.

candidate_chunk_origin.description: Where the dossier roots and parts (ctas/data/candidate-chunks/<name>.json, never manifest.json) are read from.

base_url.description: Prefix of every chunk URL: raw.githubusercontent.com, this repository, the data commit, trailing slash.

encoding.description: How the origin serves the files; raw.githubusercontent.com serves the plain JSON (identity).

branch.description: The data branch the commit was the tip of when deployed (ctas-data).

commit.description: The ctas-data commit the deployed release came from; base_url is pinned to it.

fallback_base_url.description: A second address tried only when base_url fails: the branch tip, which the manifest's checksums reject if it moved on.

pages_copy.description: false when the deployed site does not carry the chunk files itself.
